ingredients: Wholegrain oats, sugar, wholegrain corn, corn starch, corn syrup. Contains 2% or less of: dextrose, modified corn starch, salt, trisodium phosphate, gelatin, Red 40, Yellow 5 and 6, Blue 1, natural and artificial flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) added to preserve freshness. Vitamins and minerals: Calcium carbonate, vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), iron and zinc (mineral nutrients), vitamin B1 (niacinamide), vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), vitamin B1 (thiamine mononitrate), vitamin A (palmitate), vitamin B2 (riboflavin), vitamin B6 (folic acid), vitamin B12, vitamin D3.
